explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 104 to 69 lines (33.7%) and from 7,802 to 5,053 characters (35.2%). Five peripheral trees expand modular boundaries, compiler/evidence lifetimes, incremental reuse, dependency graph analysis, and pinned diagram joins. Each connects to its corresponding central concept. Positions use measured text dimensions with gaps between all diagrams.

Containment and lexical scope are combined conceptually as modular structure, while accurately retaining the implementation's five stored views. Ownership is explored through compiler state and checkpoint lifetimes. Dependency graphs remain distinct from the partitions used to organize their entities. Calls describe static evidence; the supplied schema reserves runtime identities but does not establish observed activation traces.

Source-grounded corrections: schema.ts names the lexical relations scope-parent and declares, replacing the seed's scopes and declarations. incremental.ts retains prior dependency edges when both endpoints remain local; it does not establish that those edges are still valid. derive.ts limits the single-group partition to the filtered eligible universe, despite its 'All source entities' label.

Details absent from the seed include caller-specific external summaries, constructor parameter-to-field flow, optional exported metadata that the supplied declaration indexing does not populate, cloned checkpoint boundaries, metrics being absent from fragment cache keys, removedFiles meaning removal from selection, SCC exclusion of isolated entities, and duplicate concept-partition checks. These come from the pinned declarations.ts, context.ts, incremental.ts, derive.ts, schema.ts and sourceJoins.ts.

Uncertainty is retained: imported extractor, metric, persistence and findings helpers whose bodies are not supplied are represented only through visible calls or schema contracts. Coverage marked complete is persisted-site accounting, not proof of exhaustive analysis. No runtime behavior or complete export-visibility map is inferred.

Static Architecture Analysis

|   |-- Repository root/ID, tsconfig, selected paths, views, frameworks, metrics
|   |-- Selection limits emission; imports may be read for symbol resolution
|   |-- Result: AnalysisArtifact + separate elapsed/RSS/phase measurements
|   `-- Execution metadata records whether semantic resolution was used
|-- Direct CLI: select -> analyze -> persist [scripts/analysis/analyze.ts]
|   |-- Read tsconfig; select .ts/.tsx excluding .d.ts; optional path prefixes
|   |-- Request all five stored views and react/zustand/tldraw/controller
|   |-- Directory/layer/single-group partitions; shuffle seed 1729, samples 32
|   |-- Call staticAnalyzer directly, independently of interactive backend
|   `-- Artifact gzip + architecture report + separate run manifest
|       `-- Temporary files -> rename; measurements stay outside artifact facts
|-- Modular structure: boundaries + name visibility + imports
|   |-- Declarations.index -> imports -> composition [declarations.ts]
|   |-- Components grouped here by responsibility, abstracting file hierarchy
|   |-- Declarations/scopes retain local bindings and value/type namespaces
|   |-- Local lookup walks scopes; imports/member resolution uses TypeChecker
|   |-- Import/reexport edges retain specifiers and type-only flags
|   `-- Stored containment + lexical views remain separate [schema.ts]
|       `-- Lexical kinds: scope-parent, declares, references, captures, captures-this
|-- Extraction and resource lifetime [analyzer.ts, context.ts]
|   |-- AnalysisContext validates config/selection; starts a syntax-only program
|   |   `-- First symbol/type query creates full program + lazy TypeChecker
|   |-- Any requested view beyond containment -> extractLexical
|   |-- Any calls/ownership/dependencies -> Resources -> calls -> frameworks
|   |   `-- Ownership/dependencies -> prepare symbols -> release compiler
|   |       `-- extractDataflow -> connectCallbackCandidates
|   |-- finish snapshot -> release context/caches -> deriveAnalysis -> return
|   `-- Call relations are static evidence; runtime trace identities are reserved
|-- Evidence-bearing artifact [schema.ts, context.ts]
|   |-- Snapshot: source/config hashes, UTF-16 lengths, options and versions
|   |   `-- Analyzed/resolution-only/configuration roles; commit and dirty inputs
|   |-- Entity/relation/uncertainty provenance: status, method, rule, locations
|   |   `-- Supporting relation IDs + explanation; ranges pin snapshot/path/hash
|   |-- Entity identity: owner/path/kind/name or structural fingerprint
|   |   `-- Collisions mark ambiguity, add occurrence ordinal and report an issue
|   |-- Ownership contract: creates, retains, aliases, mutation/disposal, escapes
|   |-- Dependency contract: value/argument/return, reads/writes, control/reactive
|   |-- Containment edges always allowed; other edges require an active view
|   `-- Coverage rebuilt from persisted relation/uncertainty sites
|       `-- Requested views: complete or partial; unrequested views: not-run
|-- Dependency graphs and architectural groupings [derive.ts]
|   |-- Universe: eligible source entities with evidence in analyzed files
|   |   `-- Exclude containers, scopes, interfaces/types and external/unknown nodes
|   |-- Partitions: directory, metadata layer, or one group over eligible universe
|   |-- Active calls view -> calls/constructs layer
|   |-- Active dependencies view -> data, state and reactive layers
|   |   `-- Resolved/inferred evidence; unit-per-relation weighting policy
|   |-- evaluateAllPartitions; directory comparison when present
|   |   `-- Metric contract: coverage/overlap, edge mass, cohesion, VI, shuffle baseline
|   |-- Per-layer SCCs -> condensed edges with supporting relation IDs
|   `-- deriveFindings + contains-based tree occurrences
|-- Optional IncrementalAnalyzer session [incremental.ts]
|   |-- Own checkpoint fragments; reject concurrent updates
|   |-- Inventory hashes, current import resolutions and environment
|   |-- Current imports + prior edges whose endpoints remain local -> components
|   |-- Unknown global effects -> conservative single-component fallback
|   |-- Component key hit -> reuse; miss -> extract selected component files
|   `-- Merge facts -> fresh snapshot -> recompute all derived results
|       `-- Publish checkpoint after successful assembly; report file reuse/changes
`-- Diagram boundary: pinned leaf ranges -> source entities [sourceJoins.ts]
    |-- joinSourceRange is separate from the direct CLI extraction path
    |-- Snapshot/file/hash mismatch -> stale; invalid pinned bounds -> throw
    |-- Valid range: fully-contained or intersects -> sorted eligible entity IDs
    |   `-- Nonempty -> matched; empty -> unmapped; never silently rebase
    `-- partitionFromSourceJoins -> concept partition for a supplied universe
        |-- Only matched joins at the requested diagram revision contribute
        `-- Preserve overlap; lexicographically smallest group ID is primary

Modular boundaries and visibility
|-- Application contract [ports.ts]
|   |-- Exported request/result types and StaticAnalyzer interface
|   `-- Infrastructure staticAnalyzer implements analyze(request)
|-- Analysis responsibilities
|   |-- AnalysisContext owns compiler access and fact accumulation
|   |-- Declarations indexes names and resolves references
|   `-- Domain deriveAnalysis consumes the finished artifact
|-- Local name visibility [declarations.ts]
|   |-- var binds to functionScope; other declarations use current scope
|   |-- Type-only names stay out of the local value-binding map
|   |-- Lookup walks ancestor scopes; aliases can use TypeChecker
|   `-- this receiver walks past arrows to a non-arrow function or class
|-- Boundary dependencies [declarations.ts]
|   |-- imports/reexports link modules; retain specifier and typeOnly
|   |-- External declaration summaries belong to the referencing module
|   |   `-- Summary cache is keyed by declaration and referencing file
|   `-- Resolved component JSX tags add jsx-child relations
|-- Constructor parameter properties cross two roles
|   |-- Parameter entity supplies a distinct field entity on the class
|   `-- value-flow: parameter -> field, when dependencies view is active
`-- Visibility evidence has limits [schema.ts, declarations.ts]
    |-- Schema permits optional exported metadata
    `-- Supplied declaration indexing does not populate that flag

Compiler and evidence lifetimes
|-- AnalysisContext acquires compiler state [context.ts]
|   |-- Initial program: noLib=true, noResolve=true, types=[]
|   |-- Host reads original UTF-8 text, preserving BOM and line endings
|   `-- checker access builds full program and caches TypeChecker
|-- Reuse has a lifetime beyond one analysis
|   |-- Module-level previousProgram may retain a semantic program
|   |-- Reuse source AST only when current file text is unchanged
|   `-- Selections over 100 files clear previousProgram
|-- Ownership/dependencies path [analyzer.ts, declarations.ts]
|   |-- prepareDataflow resolves property accesses and destructuring inputs
|   |-- releaseCompiler pins inputs, then drops active program/checker
|   `-- Dataflow and callback passes run after compiler release
|-- Pinning preserves evidence before release [context.ts]
|   |-- Local compiler inputs become resolution-only snapshot entries
|   |-- Outside-root inputs contribute basename/hash pairs to config hash
|   `-- finish assigns snapshot ID to every fact's provenance ranges
|-- Final cleanup [analyzer.ts, context.ts]
|   |-- finish copies entities/relations from maps into artifact arrays
|   |-- release clears selected sources and working maps
|   |-- Analyzer clears reference array and declaration-owned maps
|   `-- deriveAnalysis receives the retained artifact
`-- Coverage is site accounting, not a completeness proof
    |-- Site key: path + start offset + end offset
    |-- An uncertainty at a site takes precedence over a relation there
    `-- No unresolved sites leaves a requested view marked complete

Incremental session ownership and reuse
|-- IncrementalAnalyzer owns checkpoint and busy flag [incremental.ts]
|   |-- analyze rejects concurrent updates; finally clears busy
|   |-- exportCheckpoint returns a structured clone
|   `-- restoreCheckpoint validates version, keys, artifacts and scopes
|       `-- Reject restore while busy; retain a clone of accepted input
|-- Inventory reconstructs current resolution before cache lookup
|   |-- Local file hashes + import targets, including missing targets
|   |-- Environment includes compiler/options and package manifests
|   `-- Prior dependency edges retained if both endpoints remain local
|-- Conservative fallback: one component across local files
|   |-- Global scripts or module/global augmentations
|   |-- Dynamic import/require without a string-literal target
|   |-- Selected declarations or declarations depending on local code
|   `-- Node16/NodeNext module resolution
|-- Fragment key determines reuse
|   |-- Environment + selected members + all member hashes/resolutions
|   |-- Matching key reuses artifact and semantic-resolution flag
|   `-- Metrics settings are absent from key; derivation always reruns
|-- Assembly refreshes evidence even when all fragments are reused
|   |-- Any semantic fragment -> initialize fresh context checker
|   |-- Preserve nested package configuration pins from fragments
|   `-- Merge facts -> finish/release -> derive -> publish checkpoint
`-- Update report describes selection and work
    |-- changedFiles compares current selected hashes with prior analyzed
    |-- removedFiles means no longer selected, even if still on disk
    `-- analyzed/reused lists record selected files in each component

Dependency graph lenses and partitions
|-- Facts precede grouping [derive.ts]
|   |-- Eligible source entities define the partition universe
|   |-- Directory/layer partitions assign one group per entity
|   `-- Single-group partition covers that same filtered universe
|-- Active views select relation subsets
|   |-- calls: calls + constructs
|   |-- data: value-flow + argument + return + reads + writes
|   |-- state: reads + writes
|   `-- reactive: reactive + selects + prop-flow
|       `-- Also context-read + effect-dependency
|-- Layer policy: resolved/inferred; unit-per-relation; excludeSelfEdges
|   `-- control/awaits and ownership kinds are absent from these layers
|-- Partition evaluation [derive.ts, schema.ts]
|   |-- evaluateAllPartitions receives directory comparison if available
|   |-- Contract includes coverage/overlap and categorized edge mass
|   |-- Cohesion + variation of information + seeded shuffle baseline
|   |   `-- Baseline contract preserves primary group sizes/covered set
|   `-- Metric values are ok(value) or na(reason)
|       `-- Examples: empty universe, zero denominator, insufficient baseline
|-- SCC construction [derive.ts]
|   |-- Filter by layer view/kinds/statuses and eligible endpoints
|   |-- Only endpoints of retained edges participate; isolated nodes omitted
|   |-- Iterative Kosaraju avoids recursive traversal
|   `-- Condensed cross-component edges retain relation IDs
`-- Other projections remain distinct
    |-- deriveFindings is invoked; schema assessment is investigate
    `-- contains -> one occurrence per artifact entity; liftedEdges=[]

Pinned diagram evidence to concept groups
|-- joinSourceRange checks the pin first [sourceJoins.ts]
|   |-- Snapshot mismatch, missing file or hash mismatch -> stale
|   |   `-- Empty entityIds; no attempt to rebase
|   `-- Valid pin but negative/reversed/out-of-file offsets -> throw
|-- Entity selection uses source origin and eligible kind
|   |-- Callables/classes, parameters/bindings/fields
|   |-- Definition/merge/allocation/expression/statement/state-resource
|   `-- Compare provenance locations with matching path and file hash
|-- Range policies use UTF-16 offsets; end is exclusive [schema.ts]
|   |-- fully-contained: entity start >= leaf start AND end <= leaf end
|   |-- intersects: entity start < leaf end AND end > leaf start
|   `-- Sorted IDs -> matched if any; otherwise unmapped
|       `-- Schema also permits ambiguous; this function never returns it
|-- partitionFromSourceJoins validates supplied groups and universe
|   |-- Reject duplicate group IDs and duplicate universe members
|   |-- Map each leaf to every group that lists it
|   `-- Use only matched joins at the requested diagramRevisionId
`-- Concept partition retains overlap without inventing membership
    |-- Entities outside supplied universe contribute no memberships
    |-- Sort group IDs; primaryGroupId is the first or null
    `-- Unmatched universe members remain present with empty groupIds
